_about: One licence policy for bases (dh pool) and component registries (tryon registry). Permissive = anyone may use, modify, sell and keep the result closed, with attribution. Read by dhlib/vet.py and tryon/lib/vet.mjs. Committed-secret patterns live in data/secrets.json.

accepted.Apache-2.0: keep LICENSE + NOTICE; state changes you made
accepted.BSD-3-Clause: keep the copyright notice; no endorsement using the authors' names

refused.AGPL-3.0: network copyleft: running it as a website obliges you to publish your whole app's source
refused.GPL-2.0: copyleft: derivative work must be GPL
refused.GPL-3.0: copyleft: derivative work must be GPL
refused.LGPL-2.1: library copyleft: modifications must stay LGPL — not a base you can own
refused.LGPL-3.0: library copyleft: modifications must stay LGPL — not a base you can own
refused.MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft: modified files must stay MPL
refused.CC-BY-SA-4.0: share-alike (copyleft) and not meant for code
refused.NOASSERTION: the licence text is not a standard one — custom terms (often "MIT + Commons Clause" or a paid tier); refused unless a lawyer says otherwise
refused.NONE: no licence = all rights reserved: you may read it, not use it
